decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing the power of the partner commanders Livio and Malcolm to create a fast-paced aggro strategy. The deck includes a wide range of counterspells and removal spells to control the board while deploying threats that can quickly close out the game. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Jace, and Gideon, along with equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Umezawa's Jitte, provides additional ways to pressure opponents and maintain a dominating position on the battlefield. By combining efficient creatures with disruptive spells and potent support cards, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless stream of threats and reinforcement, securing victory through a combination of aggression and control.

This deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive board presence using cheap and efficient creatures and spells, backed up by burn and tempo cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Adeliz, the Cinder Wind serves as the commander, providing additional power to your wizards and allowing for explosive turns with spells. The goal is to quickly establish a threatening board state while keeping up pressure on the opponent, using cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Goblin Guide, and Soul-Scar Mage to chip away at their life total. By combining efficient creatures with a suite of burn spells and counterspells, this deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize or mount a defense.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells to pressure and disrupt the opponent in a 1 vs 1 Duel Commander format. With Jirina Kudro as the commander, the deck includes a mix of efficient creatures like Champion of the Parish, General Kudro of Drannith, and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, Lightning Bolt, and Dreadbore to control the board. Additionally, key utility cards such as Stoneforge Mystic, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Embercleave provide extra value and flexibility in combat. The deck aims to apply consistent pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the battlefield to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using control elements such as counterspells, bounce spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain board control. The goal is to protect the commander, Venser, Shaper Savant, while also utilizing powerful spells like Cryptic Command and Narset, Parter of Veils to dictate the pace of the game. The deck excels at tempo plays, bouncing threats, and denying resources to the opponent. By leveraging powerful spells like Echo of Eons and Time Spiral, the deck can refill its hand and keep the pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Nexus of Fate provide alternate win conditions if needed.

This deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing the partner commanders Kraum and Livio to maintain a fast pace and pressure the opponent. The deck includes a mix of efficient removal spells, counterspells, and versatile creatures to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Lightning Bolt, Swords to Plowshares, and Spell Queller provide removal options while cards like Snapcaster Mage and True-Name Nemesis offer powerful threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells, with a mix of dual lands and fetch lands. Overall, the deck aims to maintain momentum, apply pressure, and control the game to secure a win.

The deck revolves around utilizing enchantments to lock down opponents' resources and control the game. Sythis, Harvest's Hand serves as the commander, drawing cards whenever you cast an enchantment. The deck includes a variety of enchantments such as Oblivion Ring, Ghostly Prison, and Parallax Wave to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect your own. Additionally, cards like Sterling Grove and Greater Auramancy provide protection for your enchantments. The mana base is optimized with various fetch lands and mana fixing enchantments like Utopia Sprawl and Fertile Ground. Overall, the key strategy is to establish a strong enchantment presence on the battlefield while disrupting opponents to gain control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the powerful landfall abilities of The Gitrog Monster in order to generate card advantage and ramp up mana quickly. By utilizing a combination of lands with sacrifice abilities, land tutors, and recursion effects, the deck aims to ramp up quickly while disrupting opponents with targeted removal and hand disruption spells. The Gitrog Monster acts as a key combo piece, enabling the player to draw additional cards and fuel their graveyard recursion engines. The deck is designed to be resilient and adaptable, able to generate a strong board presence and outvalue opponents over the long game while also disrupting their strategies and stopping their key plays.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. Esika, God of the Tree provides a strong value engine as the commander, allowing for flexibility in casting spells. The deck includes a wide range of interaction, from counterspells like Cryptic Command and Mana Leak to removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Abrupt Decay. Card draw and selection are also key components, with cards like Brainstorm, Fact or Fiction, and Jace, the Mind Sculptor helping to ensure a steady stream of resources. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plans while establishing control of the battlefield, ultimately leading to victory through attrition and resource advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a diverse range of disruptive spells and creatures, all while taking advantage of the card advantage and versatility provided by Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the commander. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, counter spells, and disruptive creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the battlefield. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through efficient card draw and selection from Niv-Mizzet's ability, while also having access to a variety of different colors to answer a wide range of threats. By maintaining control of the game and outmaneuvering the opponent, this deck seeks to secure victory through attrition and strategic decision-making.

The deck is focused on assembling a fast and aggressive strategy utilizing a combination of low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Adeliz, the Cinder Wind acts as the commander, providing a powerful boost to wizards whenever instants and sorceries are cast. The deck includes a variety of cheap and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Burst Lightning to deal direct damage to the opponent or remove threats from the board. Additionally, creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide can attack early and put pressure on the opponent. The goal is to maintain tempo by casting spells efficiently while utilizing the commander's ability to close out the game quickly.

This deck revolves around using Klothys, God of Destiny as the commander to apply aggressive pressure on the opponent. The deck includes a mix of efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Questing Beast, along with disruptive spells like Blood Moon and Cindervines to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes powerful mana dorks like Arbor Elf and Birds of Paradise to ramp up and cast threats ahead of schedule. With a focus on dealing damage quickly and efficiently, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own board presence. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate provide additional reach to close out the game swiftly.

This deck revolves around using Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy as the commander to assemble powerful combos and generate massive amounts of mana. The deck includes a wide range of mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Bloom Tender to ramp up quickly, as well as various artifact tutors like Transmute Artifact and Whir of Invention to search for combo pieces. The deck also features cards like Freed from the Real and Pemmin's Aura to untap creatures for infinite mana combos. With cards like Eldritch Evolution and Birthing Pod, the deck can tutor for key creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Walking Ballista to close out the game quickly. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and overwhelm opponents with its mana advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. Dragonlord Ojutai serves as a strong control commander, protecting the player and providing card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies by countering key spells, removing threatening creatures, and drawing into crucial answers. It also includes various utility lands to further control the board state. The goal is to outvalue opponents through card advantage and strategic play, eventually winning the game through incremental advantages and efficient threats. Each card in the deck serves a specific purpose in maintaining control of the game, ensuring that the player can dictate the pace and outcome of the match.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Counterspell, and Deadly Rollick, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from establishing a board presence. With planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and Aminatou, the Fateshifter, the deck can generate card advantage and outvalue the opponent over time. The deck also includes cards like Detention Sphere, Vindicate, and Toxic Deluge to deal with threats on the board. Additionally, the deck has access to powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Enlightened Tutor to find key cards when needed.

The deck revolves around generating massive amounts of mana to ramp quickly into powerful threats and disrupt opponents. It utilizes cards like Titania, Protector of Argoth, Primeval Titan, and Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider to apply constant pressure and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Crucible of Worlds and Ramunap Excavator to recur lands and maintain a strong mana base. With the ability to tutor for key cards using Green Sun's Zenith and Worldly Tutor, as well as protect important creatures with cards like Heroic Intervention and Snakeskin Veil, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence and finish off opponents with its efficient threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of cards that support an aggressive playstyle with the commander Grist, the Hunger Tide. It includes a mix of efficient removal spells, powerful creatures, and disruptive spells to control the board and put pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Hymn to Tourach, and Duress, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Tarmogoyf, Questing Beast, and Primeval Titan provide powerful threats that can quickly close out the game. The deck also includes cards that support Grist's ability to create insect tokens, such as Bitterblossom and Bloodghast, allowing for additional aggression and board presence. With a strong mana base and a variety of versatile cards, this deck aims to outpace and overwhelm the opponent in a 1 vs 1 Duel Commander match.
